verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a public REST API. Its endpoint reference covers searching people with field selection, custom-field filtering and smart lists, sending in leads and events, attaching files, logging texts, triggering automations and applying action plans. Probes confirm the docs are live, including llms.txt and markdown versions built for agents. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), evidence on authentication and rate limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Follow Up Boss provides a simple [REST API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) that allows developers to integrate their applications quickly.
